classification.difficultyReason: Apply the known semicircular arc formula in reverse, include two explicit platforms and use curved length times length.

content.prompt: A skateboard ramp, a cross-section of which is shown opposite, consists of a half-cylinder with platforms of width 2 m. The curved part of the ramp has length 12.5 m.

spec.description: Exact source concave semicircular cross-section with two2m platforms and12.5m curved length. Decorative ground slab omitted; outer ground/bottom has no extra given. Correct stem unit cm to m follows source diagram and actual key.
spec.answerVisibility: Only original givens, no computed answer values.

children.label: a
children.prompt: Find the radius of the cylinder, correct to 2 decimal places.

children.label: b
children.prompt: Find, correct to 2 decimal places, the total width of the ramp, including the platform.

answer.worked:
The total width is the diameter plus both 2 m platforms. Use the unrounded radius.
$$\begin{aligned}w&=2+2r+2=4+\frac{25}{\pi}\\w&\approx11.96\text{ m}.\end{aligned}$$

children.label: c
children.prompt: If the ramp is 8 m long, find the surface area of the curved part of the ramp.
